message.dotcraftenergy.kite.none: No kite. Use a kite on the generator; sneak with an empty hand to take it back.
message.dotcraftenergy.kite.state.no_wir: No wire, the kite stays on the ground. Right-click with iron wire: 1 wire = 1 m of tether (%1$s of %2$s).
message.dotcraftenergy.kite.state.too_cl: Another kite generator is only %4$s m away (minimum %3$s m): both kites stay down.
message.dotcraftenergy.kite.status: Kite at %1$s m, wire %2$s of %5$s m, %3$s FE/t (%4$s)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.flow.axis: Front and back must stay free for the water (a solid block there: 0 FE); gives FE to the other sides
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.flow.formula: Must be waterlogged (risk of explosion otherwise): peak x water share x biome x (1 + animals)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.flow.perk_1: Baseline: needs a nearly full cube of water
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.flow.perk_2: Wide net: animals count within 6 blocks
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.flow.perk_3: Adaptation: keeps 75% outside ocean and river
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.flow.perk_4: Lean water: a small pond is already enough
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.distance: Keep %s m from other kite generators, or both stay down.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.1: Plain kite: needs a free 3x3 way up, rain halves the output, a storm reels it in.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.2: Waxed line: rain costs only a quarter.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.3: Rain-proof sail; ignores obstructions: blocks above and a crowded sky cost nothing.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.4: Storm line: flies in a thunderstorm at half output; a crowded sky costs half as much. Two kites (+-4 m play) share the base. In a storm the kite stays within 6 m of the axis and lightning within 6 m is drawn to it: 1,000,000 FE, rarely.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.perk.5: Insulated tether: ignores thunder and a crowded sky. Two kites (+-4 m play) share the base. In a storm the kite stays within 6 m of the axis and lightning within 6 m is drawn to it: 1,000,000 FE, rarely.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.tether: Tether: %s m (the longer, the more FE: output = base x tether / 64)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.kite.wire: Needs iron wire as tether: right-click with it, 1 wire = 1 m (at most %s).
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.melt.tank: Water goes into a tank of %s buckets that can only be drained
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.melt.tank_full: A full tank leaves %s%% of the FE per ice until water is drained
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.thermo: Peak %1$s FE/t at a temperature difference of %2$s
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.thermo.hint: Needs a hot and a cold neighbour on opposite sides (levels 1-3 each, they add up to the difference)
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.vibration.hearing: Hears shocks within %1$s blocks, from vibration frequency %2$s
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.vibration.needs: Powered by shocks nearby: blocks broken, fights, explosions
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.vibration.peak: Peak %1$s FE/t, on average at most %2$s FE/t
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.perk.3: Small mobs pull their full weight.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.perk.5: Flywheel: keeps turning for a few seconds after the mob stops.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.rules: Captures the first mob that stands on top of it (one at a time, any mob, hostile too) and holds it there: it cannot leave but can still be hurt and killed, and never despawns. Mobs nearby do not count. Health and speed set the weight, a mob that tries to walk counts fully, a standing one half. No babies, no mobs in water, one wheel per mob. A comparator reads the load.
tooltip.dotcraftenergy.wheel.stats: Up to %s FE/t from one mob on the wheel
